title: Direct Entry: Wynwood Walls Spray Paint on Canvas Art Class
includes: All art class materials (canvas, paint, brushes, ponchos, and gloves)
Umbrellas available to borrow during your visit if you’d like extra protection from the sun or rain
Access to the official Wynwood Walls app for self-guided audio tours and augmented reality murals
Handheld fans (available for purchase at the Wynwood Walls Welcome Center) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have a high level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Unleash your creativity in a vibrant urban art class where you'll learn the fundamentals of spray paint and stencil artistry. Guided by iconic stencils from renowned artists like OBEY and Ron English, you’ll create your very own canvas artwork inspired by the Wynwood Walls. This ticket not only includes access to 38+ stunning murals and sculptures but also grants entry to local artist pop-ups and the Goldman Global Arts Galleries. Enjoy complimentary spray painting at the Street Art Experience and take home a unique piece of art that reflects your creative journey.
